answer.rationale: Expiry in 14 days with no auto-renew plus a 94% loaded line and no buffer make continuity the binding constraint under the stated objective. Incumbent already refused a price reopen, so negotiate_terms is unlikely to deliver the 18% cut (c4 is stale relative to that refusal). A primary switch would meet the spend mandate and c2 reports a clean prior onboarding, but any transition still raises delivery risk that the objective forbids given zero buffer; that read of c2 is uncertain enough to verify. Deferral is unsafe on critical supply (c5 was non-critical month-to-month). Renewing the incumbent (c1) keeps integration and scheduled deliveries intact; cost takeout waits for the next cycle. Verifying c1 and c2 before commit.
